newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, Oct 7 to 13 - Bourgas - Thirty-four vessels operating of which 16 loading, 1 zinc/marble, 2 copper, 1 lead, 3 general, 1 timber, 1 construction, 1 clinker, 3 steel, 1 cars, 1 metal, 1 chemicals. 11 Discharging, 1 cars, 1 fishmeal, 1 salt, 1 coal, 2 iron ore, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 sugar, 3 petrol. 3 Discharging/loading, 2 containers/general, 1 salt/general. 3 Discharging/loading containers, 1 empty vessel. 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 1 metal, 2 general, 1 fertiliser, 1 cars, 2 chemicals, 1 awaiting orders, 3 cargo not nominated. 1 For repairs, 2 to discharge of which 1 sugar, 1 coal. 18 Vessels due of which 10 to load, 3 metal, 5 fertiliser, 1 steel, 1 bentonite. 10 to discharge, 3 iron ore, 2 zinc concentrate, 2 salt, 2 coal, 1 cars. 8 To discharge, 2 sugar, 1 salt, 1 copper/zinc, 1 cars, 2 coal, 1 ethanol.

Varna - Thirty-two vessels operating of which 21 loading, 2 tsp, 4 soda, 2 clinker, 1 glass, 1 kaoline, 4 cement, 2 fertiliser, 3 quartz sand, 1 cigarettes, 1 edc. 6 Discharging, 1 sugar, 1 phosphorite, 1 pipes, 1 coal, 1 trucks, 1 containers/timber, 3 discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 1 quartz sand, 1 clinker, 1 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 6 cargo not nominated.

Oct 14 - Varna - East - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 awaiting orders. West - 9 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Bourgas - East - 23 Vessels due, 4 loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth. 12 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 under repairs/drydock. West - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

CROATIA, October 14 - Rijeka - Five vessels discharging at berth, 6 loading at berth, 7 under repair/drydock, 7 due, delays expected. 3 Vessels anchored, 3 berthed operative. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 due, delays expected. 1 Vessel under repair/drydock. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Split, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, October 15 - Limassol - Vessels due on 16/10, 4 container vessels, 3 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels, 1 cruise vessel, no delays expected. 6 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 5 conventional vessels discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - Vessels due on 16/10, 2 container vessels, 2 conventional vessels, no delays expected. 1 container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, October 14 - Tallinn city port - 2 Liner vessels in port. Kopli - 4 Vessels due, 3 discharging at berth of which 2 meat, 1 flour. Muuga - 2 Vessels due, 2 loading at berth of which 1 black oil, 1 timber. 2 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 ore coke, 1 corn, 2 ferries in port. Parnu - 4 Vessels due, 1 loading peat at berth.

ITALY, October 15 - Naples - One container vessel and 1 coal vessel, with etb next few days. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 44 Vessels berthed, 6 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - One vessel in roads. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 8 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - Two vessels in roads, 3 berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 vessels berthed, 4 under repair. Leghorn - Five vessels in roads, 38 berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - Three vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, no vessels berthed. Palermo - Vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch - Seven vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Taranto - Six vessels in roads totalling 374,796 dwt. Ravenna - Four vessels in roads. Ancona/Falconara - One vessel in roads. Venice, Trieste - No information available.

LATVIA, October 15 - Riga - 19 Vessels in port of which 17 operating, 6 timber loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 metal loaders, 1 tanker loader, 1 scrap metal loader, 2 container loaders, 3 fish dischargers, 1 chicken discharger. 2 Vessels awaiting operations. No delays, 20 vessels due. Ventspils - Four vessels in port of which 3 operating, 1 mop loader, 2 steel loaders. 1 Vessel awaiting operations, no delays, 9 vessels due. Liepaja - Five vessels in port of which 4 operating, 1 awaiting operations. No delays, 1 vessel due.
LITHUANIA, October 7 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 salt petre, 1 potash, 1 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 cement. 5 Fish vessels discharging. 4 Vessels in roads, 37 due.

POLAND, October 15 - Szczecin - Eighty-eight vessels due, delays expected. 46 Vessels loading at berth, 42 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering. 10 Vessels under repair/drydock.

PORTUGAL, October 14 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 6 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels awaiting berth. Places vacant, 11 piers with cranes. Setubal, October 15 - Six vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at berth to discharge. 6 Vessels under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 5 for discharging, 4 for loading, 1 under repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, October 15 - Constantza - Forty vessels operating of which 21 generals (19 loading, 2 discharging), 12 bulkers (5 loading, 7 discharging), 7 bagged chemicals loading. 5 Vessels in roads of which 3 bulkers for loading, 1 bagged chemicals for loading, 1 tanker for discharging. Constantza (Agigea) - Five vessels operating of which 4 loading general, 1 bulker discharging. Mangalia - No vessels in port. Midia - One livestock carrier loading.

RUSSIA, October 15 - FAR EAST PORTS - Vladivostok - Thirteen vessels in port of which 1 passenger. 7 Vessels loading (3 metal, 2 timber, 1 general cargo, 1 woodpulp), 1 container discharging/loading, 4 waiting. Nakhodka - Ten vessels in port of which 7 loading (4 metal, 2 timber, 1 general cargo), 3 waiting. Vostochniy - Ten vessels in port of which 6 loading (3 coal, 1 metal, 1 aluminium, 1 timber). 3 Container vessels discharging/loading. 1 Vessel waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading metal. Khasan - Two vessels in port of which 1 loading metal, 1 waiting. No delays or congestion in ports.

BALTIC PORTS - Kaliningrad - Four vessels operating of which 1 timber loader, 1 fertiliser loader, 1 bananas discharger, 1 sugar discharger. No delays, 1 vessel due. Vyborg - One vessel operating, no delays, 4 vessels due. St. Petersburg - Commercial port - 22 Vessels operating of which loading, 5 non-ferrous, 1 machinery, 1 container vessel, 4 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 general. Discharging - 1 Frozen chicken, 1 frozen meat, 3 containers, 1 fruit, 2 general, 1 machinery. 9 Vessels awaiting operations, 9 due. Northern basin - Murmansk - Seven vessels operating of which 2 alumina, 1 coal, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 cabotage. No berthing delays, 9 vessels due during the week of which 6 loaders (3 apatite, 1 steel, 1 coal, 1 npk). 3 Dischargers (1 alumina, 2 cabotage).

BLACK SEA, October 14 - Novorossiysk - Fourteen vessels operating of which 7 loading, 1 general, 3 steel, 1 scrap, 1 fertiliser, 1 molasses. 6 Discharging, 1 various, 1 citrus, 1 bananas, 2 rice, 1 tobacco. 1 Discharging/loading various/cars. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load, 1 molasses, 1 cellulose, 1 seeds, 1 blooms. 4 To discharge, 3 rice, 1 helicopters. 26 Vessels due of which 21 to load, 1 cement, 1 scrap, 1 cast iron, 7 steel, 2 slabs, 1 wire, 4 copper, 1 luggage, 2 seeds, 1 sugar beet. 2 To discharge, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 luggage, 1 discharging/loading cars, 2 discharging/loading containers. Oil terminal, October 15 - 2 Tankers operating of which 1 loading crude, 1 fuel oil. 5 Waiting in roads of which 4 to load crude, 1 fuel oil. 6 Vessels due of which 4 to load crude, 1 diesel oil, 1 fuel oil.

SPAIN, October 14 - Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 2 discharging (1 iron ore, 1 coal). 3 Loading (1 general cargo, 1 zinc, 1 sulphur acid. Gijon - Four vessels in port of which 1 discharging general cargo, 3 loading of which 2 steel products, 1 cement. No delays or congestion. Sagunto - Twenty-five vessels operating of which 2 ro/ro discharging/loading, 2 loading and discharging timber, 4 loading surgical products, 11 discharging surgical products, 1 loading fertiliser, 4 discharging logs, 1 discharging plumb. No vessels berthed out side commercial wharf, no berthing delays. October 15 - Pasajes - Fourteen vessels in port of which 5 discharging scrap, 1 each discharging kaoline, magnesite, sawn timber, woodpulp. 2 Discharging/loading cars, 3 loading steel, no delays. Cadiz - Sixteen vessels in port of which 4 ro/ro, 3 wheat, 1 sugar, 1 cotton, 1 cement, 1 rice, 1 clay, 1 semolina. 3 Vessels under repair, no delays.

SLOVENIA, October 14 - Koper - Nine vessels due during the next 2 days of which 4 containers for loading and discharging. 1 Bulk carrier to discharge alumina, 1 tanker for discharging gasoline, 1 general cargo to load sawn timber, 1 ferry loading and discharging, 1 livestock to load bulls. 12 vessels berthed of which 1 container loading and discharging, 1 bulk carrier loading grain, 3 bulk carriers discharging grain and alumina, 6 loading general cargo, paper, steel, sawn timber, 1 livestock carrier loading bulls. No delays expected.

TURKEY, October 14 - Istanbul - haydarpasa - 10 Vessels operating of which 6 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. No berthing delays except for heavy lift cargoes. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 15 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Iskenderun - One vessel discharging timber, 1 loading copper ore, 1 loading chrome ore. Yazicilar - One vessel discharging scrap iron, 1 loading cement, 1 vessel anchored. Ekinciler - One vessel discharging scrap iron. Isdemir - Two vessels discharging coal, 1 loading pig iron, 2 vessels anchored. Toros - Two vessels anchored. Mersin - Twenty vessels operating of which loading, 1 citrus, 2 pulses, 1 general cargo, 1 livestock. Discharging, 3 wheat, 2 rice, 1 oil, 1 paper, 2 cotton, 1 manure, both import/export of 2 vehicle vessels, 3 container vessels. 13 Vessels anchored. October 15 - Mersin - Eighteen vessels awaiting orders. 17 Vessels operating of which loading, 2 citrus, 1 barley, 1 bulk mineral, 1 legumes, 1 livestock. Discharging, 1 rice, 1 bananas, 1 pyroxylin, 1 bulk oil, 1 paper, 1 wheat. Loading/disarging, 4 containers, 1 container/general cargo. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel discharging rice, 2 discharging cotton. Seka - One vessel discharging fertiliser.

UKRAINE, October 14 - Mariupol - Five vessels operating in port of which 2 loading, 1 mop, 1 slabs. 2 Discharging, 1 alumina, 1 equipment. 1 Discharging/loading containers. 6 Vessels waiting in roads for loading of which 1 sulphur, 2 coal, 1 sunflower seeds, 1 urea, 1 containers. 29 Vessels due of which 18 to load, 3 fertiliser, 4 coal, 1 sunflower seeds, 6 steel, 2 slabs, 1 debars, 1 slabs/pipes. 4 To discharge, 1 bananas, 1 bauxite, 1 fluorspar, 1 coal. 6 To discharge/load containers, 1 to discharge/load equipment/ferrous metals. Odessa, October 15 - Fourteen vessels operating of which 7 loading, 1 seedcake, 4 metal, 1 paper, 1 steel. 2 Discharging, 1 bananas, 1 laurel leaf. 1 Discharging/loading containers, 2 passenger vessels, 2 under repair. 3 Vessels in roads of which 2 anchored, 1 cargo not nominated. 9 Vessels due of which 4 to load metal. 3 to discharge, 1 sugar, 1 bananas, 1 citric plant, 2 passenger vessels.

October 15 - Mariupol - Six vessels loading at berth (sulphur, coal, general cargo, fertiliser). 4 Vessels discharging at berth (alumina, general cargo, fertiliser, sunflower seeds). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (sunflower seed, urea, general cargo, sulphur, fertiliser). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (sunflower seed, bananas). 9 Floating orehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 27 Vessels due (general cargo, fertiliser, metal products, coal, sulphur). Kerch - Four vessels under repair/drydock. 4 Vessels due for discharging/loading (ore/general cargo, ore, metal products). Berdiansk - One fertiliser loading at berth, 1 due to load fertiliser. Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 6 vessels alongside, 3 due. Containers, 1 vessel alongside. Grain cargo loading, 1 vessel alongside. Tanker discharging, 1 vessel alongside. Tanker loading, 1 vessel alongside. General cargo, 2 vessels alongside, 2 due. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading, 9 vessels alongside, 2 anchored. Containers, 1 Vessel alongside. Bulk cargo, 2 vessels alongside.
YUGOSLAVIA, October 15 - Bar - Six vessels berthed of which discharging, 2 bananas, 1 iron, 1 creolite, 1 iron ore, 1 petcoke. Zelenika/Bijela - Five vessels under repair, no delays.
